In this case, the R7900 is a [[Netgear R8000|R8000]] with 256QAM disabled on the three stream 2.4GHz radio limiting its maximum theoretical speed to 450Mbps instead of 600Mbps. Also, the USB 2.0 port was removed for the R7900. While not really represented well in the infobox, this is a tri-radio device - all radios (2x 5GHz [an+ac], 1x 2.4GHz [bgn]) used are BCM43602 (''FullMAC'') is supported in the mainline '''Linux''' kernel by [[brcmfmac]] {{See also|Netgear R8000|Foxconn}} ==Links of Interest== ===Forum threads=== *[https://forum.openwrt.org/viewtopic.php?id=64056 ''Netgear R7900'' on '''OpenWrt''' forums] *[https://www.snbforums.com/threads/netgear-r7900.22339/ ''Netgear R7900'' on '''SNB''' forums] ==Flashing== {{Flashnotice}} ===Flashing OpenWrt=== {{OpenWrt |techdata = https://openwrt.org/toh/hwdata/netgear/netgear_r7900 |wikipage = |forumpage = https://forum.openwrt.org/viewtopic.php?id=64056 |github = |target = bcm53xx |subtarget = generic |arch = arm_cortex-a9 |support_commit_id = 997a3cb41c254f7b22a61ac7fac8fddf490d46a7 |support_started_version = 17.01.0 |current_supported_version = 24.10.4 |last_supported_version = |image_too_big = |unsupportedfuncntions = |lan_hardware = Broadcom BCM4709A0 |lan_comment = |wlan_hardware = Broadcom BCM43602 |wlan_comment = |usb_sata_comment = |inst_method = CFE TFTP + serial recovery |inst_comment = |rec_method = CFE TFTP + serial recovery |rec_comment = |comment = }} {{SCollapse | git • >> |
